author: Kairos I
title: Erudite Annex v12: overlay-first with full notes and dynamic sizing
abstract: Generates an overlay-first one-pager PNG that restores tail metrics, sources full per-run notes (per_run_notes.json, per-run *_notes.txt, summary meta), and adjusts figure/fonts dynamically to the number of runs. Updates annex index; TXT fallback included.
